reason: W8 introduced .github/scripts/verify_ctest.py on its parallel branch after the pinned main inventory. Separate branch supplement requested by W8 and refreshed after git fetch.

findings.description: Evidence validator accepts the named CI presets dev/asan/vendored; main CLI choices reuse this closed tuple.
findings.mechanism: Versioned preset registry consumed by validation and CLI choices; retain the exact current preset names and reject unregistered names.

findings.description: ASan non-shared availability table names two fully unavailable FFI entries and exactly two ABI skips; requires the LOOM_LIBRARY-not-set diagnostic and positive discovered counts; skipped cases are subtracted from executed counts.
findings.mechanism: Declared preset/entry/diagnostic/count rules drive a generic validator. Canonical rules preserve all-skipped versus exactly-two-skips distinction, reasons, executed>0 requirement for ABI, and rejection of every unexpected skip. Store the effective rule hash in the receipt.

findings.description: unit.test_catalog_scale with exactly zero cases and zero assertions is classified unexecuted because the existing test is opt-in; every other native entry requires positive cases and assertions.
findings.mechanism: Declared opt-in entry and its exact zero/zero absence signature; generic evidence classification explicitly lists unexecuted entries without counting them as executed. Keep positive evidence checks and rejection of ambiguous summaries.

findings.description: Entry-name dispatch chooses native doctest by unit. prefix, Python unittest by compat./research. prefixes and two exact names; unknown names fall through to script-only status without an inner count.
findings.mechanism: Registry binds exact names/prefixes to doctest, unittest or script parser IDs. Use the same adapter classification for summary totals; review new CTest registrations so unknown entries cannot silently claim inner-case coverage.

findings.description: Evidence schema name, doctest/unittest summary regexes, ANSI escape cleanup, truncation/SKIP markers and skipped=N syntax encode evidence serialization/parsing formats, not semantic analysis prompts or tunable quality thresholds.
findings.destination: Versioned evidence/parser contract; retain canonical parser code unless adopting a declared new evidence format.
findings.mechanism: Named parser adapters implement a documented evidence format. Freeze representative positive/negative fixtures; preserve complete-output validation and ambiguity rejection. Do not treat these parser regexes as semantic-analysis method data.

handoff.thread8: Own any future validator refactor; preserve existing exact classifications, skip counts, reasons, full-output checks and rejection fixtures. This supplement changes no production source, evidence gate or test threshold.
handoff.thread9: Register new CTest entries against declared parser adapters and retain unexecuted-entry accounting. This report does not independently certify W8 CI, only records its reported results and current branch source.
handoff.thread11: Keep supplement separate from the 695-group before-edit baseline and its migration totals.
